verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly document SSE streaming via "stream": true (claude-docs-7/32/48), plus fine-grained tool streaming (claude-docs-59), fast mode for up to 2.5x output speed and an effort parameter trading latency for intelligence (claude-docs-60, claude-docs-61), giving developers documented latency/streaming controls. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on benchmark confirming sub-second latency claims, and community comments touch on speed/overload issues (claude-comm-11, claude-comm-14) rather than confirming documented latency behavior.
